theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pc_minor_measurable_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (m p r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (v : Euclid m → Euclid p) (a : Fin r → Fin p) (b : Fin r → Fin m), LipschitzWith L v → Measurable (fun u => Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun s t => fderiv ℝ v u (EuclideanSpace.single (b t) 1) (a s))) ∧ ∀ u, |Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun s t => fderiv ℝ v u (EuclideanSpace.single (b t) 1) (a s))| ≤ (r.factorial : ℝ) * (L : ℝ) ^ r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
